Type: upholstered open-back dining armchair
Use: dining, accent seating; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: woven fabric upholstery with piped edges, wood legs in a dark finish
Colors: teal aqua blue, dark reddish-brown wood
Shape: rounded back with cut-out opening, short sloping arms, padded seat, four round tapered legs, compact
Feel: playful, fresh, cosy
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, mustard or brass accents; mid-century or retro rooms

product.name: Rivet Malida Mid-Century Modern Open Back Kitchen Dining Room Accent Chair, 33"H, Aqua (Renewed)
product.description: A cut-out back and tapered legs give this accent chair a classic mid-century modern design. Plenty of padding makes it sturdy and comfortable to use in the dining room or anywhere else extra seating is needed. 22.8"W x 22.1"D x 33.1"H; Seat Height is 18.5" Fabric is 100% polyester. Hardwood legs with espresso finish. Foam padding and elastic suspension system keep back and seat firm and springy No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
